title: I Took the Rideshare Pet-Fee Screenshot After They Denied the Hair

parts.text: I got a $50 pet-hair fee at 9:22 p.m. for a ride with no pet. I have a short fade and a wool coat. The photo the driver uploaded was a single light hair on a black seat. I was forty, coming from a work dinner. I screenshotted the photo, my coat, and the no-pet trip history. Then I sent it to support with the driver's previous reviews mentioning a husky. At 9:31 the driver messaged delete the report and I'll drop the fee, which is not how fees work.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: He wants the report gone in exchange for dropping a fee for a husky seat.

social.video_title: Pet-hair fee, no pet, a husky in the reviews — Part 1/2
social.description: Fade, wool coat, one hair photo. He DMed a deal. Would you have deleted the report?

parts.text: I did not delete it. Support removed the fee and flagged the photo as reuse. The husky remained loved, elsewhere. I kept the wool coat. Fees need animals that traveled. Messages about deleting reports are reports. I ride with short hair in peace. The seat was black. Light hair is a genre. Mine was not a pet. The app agreed, late, which is still yes.

social.description: Fee gone, flag placed, wool intact. Was a fade a pet?
